channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: Lorry driver “blinded by sun” when he killed cyclist cleared of careless driving
item.description: The driver claimed that the fatal crash occurred “within a couple of seconds” of his vision being impaired and that he “couldn’t have done anything differently”

item.title: Cycling fans question Tadej Pogačar riding TT bike in rainbow bands... months on from claiming he always carries spare jersey "out of respect for Remco" (but does anyone actually care?); DT Swiss recall update + more on the live blog
item.description: It's the final Friday live blog of the year and Dan Alexander enjoyed yesterday's round-up so much he's back to do it all again today

item.title: DeFeet Slipstream Strada
item.description: High cuff and thick fabric make them warm in the dry, but don't expect much weather resistance 6/10

item.title: Demi Vollering slams motorists who “didn’t even ask if I was okay” after “kissing tarmac” in training crash
item.description: “It gives me a lot of confidence in humanity. Not. Just very thankful to the one cyclist who stopped to check with me,” the 2023 Tour de France Femmes winner posted following her crash in Alicante

item.title: Tacky recycled bike parts, useless multi tools and misogynistic t-shirts: Gifts not to buy for cyclists to avoid a festive fracas
item.description: It's Christmas time, and there's a need to be afraid... allow VecchioJo to help you on your quest to buy a suitable gift for the cyclist in your life by first swerving these cycling stinkers

item.title: Triple world cyclocross champion Fem van Empel puts cycling career “on hold” and leaves Visma-Lease a Bike, admitting “the enjoyment and motivation are missing”
item.description: The 23-year-old, widely regarded as one of the sport’s most exciting prospects, says she made the decision after failing to finish the Koppenbergcross in November, admitting her “body and mind gave a very clear signal”

item.title: Hybrids are the ultimate do-it-all bikes for MTB and gravel... but the name was just never quite sexy enough
item.description: Hybrid bikes capable of going off-road have been around for years, and could perhaps be considered the original gravel bikes, or even the first of the big wheel mountain bikes. So, why did they never really take off among serious riders?

item.title: “Most drivers don’t know the rules”: Cyclist left with broken jaw as close passing motorist forces her into pothole before fleeing scene
item.description: “Cars go very fast and pass too close. People see someone on a bike and get annoyed. I’ve been shouted at many times just for cycling on the road. It’s terrifying”

item.title: Ribble will now throw in 'Custom Club Colours' on all bikes over £3,000 — plus Brooks x Paul Smith limited edition saddle, Zwift introduces long-awaited drafting feature + more
item.description: It's the last Tech of the Week before Christmas, feature new stuff from Colnago, Storck, Santini and Ribble, plus news from Zwift and some cool new cycling oil paintings for a good cause

item.title: Akeeyo 4K UHD Bike Camera
item.description: Wallet-friendly camera that may lack frills but picks up what it needs to 7/10
